values.content: Analyze the sentiment and extract insights from user feedback. Return a JSON object with sentiment (positive/negative/neutral), key_insights (array of strings), suggested_improvements (array of strings), and urgency_score (1-10).

parameters.query: INSERT INTO project_feedback (project_id, feedback_text, sentiment, key_insights, suggested_improvements, urgency_score, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $node["User Feedback Received"].json["project_id"] }}', '{{ $node["User Feedback Received"].json["feedback_text"] }}', '{{ JSON.parse($node["Analyze Feedback Sentiment"].json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]).sentiment }}', '{{ JSON.stringify(JSON.parse($node["Analyze Feedback Sentiment"].json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]).key_insights) }}', '{{ JSON.stringify(JSON.parse($node["Analyze Feedback Sentiment"].json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]).suggested_improvements) }}', {{ JSON.parse($node["Analyze Feedback Sentiment"].json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]).urgency_score }}, NOW())

SELECT p.*, array_agg(f.feedback_text) as feedback_history, array_agg(f.suggested_improvements) as all_improvements FROM vibe_projects p LEFT JOIN project_feedback f ON p.project_id = f.project_id WHERE p.project_id = '{{ $json.project_id }}' GROUP BY p.id

values.content: You are improving an existing web application based on user feedback. Generate updated code that addresses the feedback while maintaining the core functionality. Focus on the specific improvements requested.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO project_iterations (project_id, iteration_number, improvements_made, deploy_url, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $node["Manual Iteration Request"].json["project_id"] }}', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(iteration_number), 0) + 1 FROM project_iterations WHERE project_id = '{{ $node["Manual Iteration Request"].json["project_id"] }}'), '{{ JSON.stringify($node["Manual Iteration Request"].json["improvements"]) }}', '{{ $node["Deploy Updated Version"].json["url"] }}', NOW())
